name: Sword of Hours
clause: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage, roll a d12. If the result is greater than the damage dealt or the result is 12, double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'amount-compare', a: Amount, b: Amount, cmp: 'gt' | 'ge' | 'lt' | 'le' | 'eq' }
needs.semantics: A general two-amount comparison condition. 'If the result is greater than the damage dealt' is { a: { count: 'roll-result' }, b: { count: 'that-many' }, cmp: 'gt' }; `roll-result` today accepts only literal least/most bounds.
needs.clause: If the result is greater than the damage dealt or the result is 12, ...

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'double-counters', target: TargetSpec | Ref, counter: string }  and  Amount.count += 'counters-on-that'
needs.semantics: Double the number of `counter` counters on the target (put that many more on it). The amount count is the general form ('equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature'); `counters-on-source` only reads the source.
needs.clause: double the number of +1/+1 counters on that creature
